paragraphs: Eproval sells permitting software to local government offices that handle special events and film shoots. The platform has since stretched to other complex application and approval work, including government grants and filming approvals.

Each application keeps comments, emails, activity, documents and approvals in one place. Review is coordinated across the departments that have to sign off on a permit. Pricing is one annual subscription with unlimited user licenses. Reports can be built from any data the agency collects. An extra module covers payment and invoicing.

An operations manager quoted on the case studies page says Denver's Office of Special Events gained operational efficiencies after adopting the software. The company says its team has spent more than 20 years building web applications for clients in local government, tourism and chambers of commerce. It describes itself as a SaaS company working in the eGov market. A published corporate social responsibility policy states a commitment to protecting the privacy and security of client data.

quote.text: Eproval was developed in direct response to customer needs.
